purpose: Card grid of courses or services with duration, price/fee range, audience and a per-card enquiry CTA that pre-selects the course in the enquiry form.

courseOptions.description: Names exposed to the enquiry-form course selector

configurationFields.description: Hide prices when the client prefers 'Contact us for fees'

testCases.description: Render three services from the sample intake
testCases.expectedOutcome: Three cards with name, duration and price exactly as supplied
Scrolls to the enquiry form with that course pre-selected
No price text appears anywhere in the section

knownLimitations: Contract only: Angular implementation not yet built (Phase B).
rollbackApproach: Disable the module in site.config.json enabledModules and redeploy, or redeploy the previous build.
